resources.string: Maya lives on your phone but thinks on your PC. Enter the address of the PC running the brain and the token from its config.
PC address (e.g. 192.168.1.20 or a Tailscale name)
Only when I talk to her
If offline speech isn\'t available, use the phone\'s Google voice typing. It prefers offline, but Google may sometimes process your voice online.
Downloading offline English (US)… If nothing happens, tap Set up again.
Let Maya see who messages me
She only sees the app and who it\'s from (and the group name), never the message itself. Needs Notification access above.

She sees the text and buttons of the app you\'re using, so she can talk about it and sit on its buttons. Never passwords, never what you type, never the apps in the list below. On Android 11 and newer she also takes a screenshot now and then when the screen is mostly pictures, or when you ask her to look (kept in memory only, never saved). She never presses anything. Needs Screen access above.
Never watch these apps (one package per line)
Lets Maya see the text and buttons of the app you\'re using, and now and then a screenshot to see its pictures (kept in memory only, never saved). She never presses anything.
Maya is napping (can\'t reach your PC)
